name: mode-toggle
title: Mode toggle
description: The way from day to night, drawn ten ways. Three are switches with a scene change of their own: Day over Night with the full stop setting from one to the other while the page dissolves; Night taking the ink letter by letter while the page's light is lowered; Noon turning to Moon while night falls from the top. The other seven are buttons: a disc sliding over a ring, a dot setting below a hairline, a word on a hairline that rolls, the fermata as an eye, a sentence whose last word rolls, midday whose second half the ink falls over, and a clock turning from noon to midnight.
